question: Player offensive/defensive RAPM as of a date, fitted on all earlier regular-season games with exponentially decaying game weights.
inputs: Admitted regular-season stints 2014-15 to 2025-26: sealed IM03 bundles (2023-24 to 2025-26) and courtlens-impact-history-v1 bundles (2014-15 to 2022-23)
method: Design as impact-ratings-v1: per stint two offensive observations, +1 offensive indicators, +1 opponent defensive indicators, unpenalized intercept, target 100 * points / counted controls.
Home: one signed home column per season (+1 home offense, -1 away offense), instead of one column for all seasons; 2019-20 games on or after 2020-07-30 (bubble, neutral site) have home = 0.

Game weight w = 0.5 ** (age_days / half_life_days), age_days = cutoff - game_date in days, cutoff exclusive (game_date < cutoff). Observation weight = counted controls * w. Games with w < min_weight are dropped (age_days > 1827 for the registered parameters).
Ridge: scikit-learn 1.6.1 Ridge, lsqr, tol 1e-10, max_iter 10000, float64, one thread; an exhausted iteration budget fails the fit.
Centering: offense and defense coefficients separately, weighted by decayed player seconds; DRAPM = -defense coefficient; RAPM = ORAPM + DRAPM.
Season-end fits: one per regular season 2014-15 to 2025-26 with cutoff = day after the season's last admitted regular-season game.
selection: Alpha by 3 shuffled game-grouped folds (seed 2501, sorted game ids) inside the fit window, minimizing decayed-weight pooled validation MSE; exact ties prefer smaller alpha. The selected alpha is refitted on the whole window. If the selected alpha is a grid endpoint it is reported as such; the grid is not widened after seeing results.
uncertainty: Season-end fits get game-bootstrap intervals under courtlens-impact-intervals-v1.
evaluation: Chronological diagnostic per season 2015-16 to 2025-26: fit with cutoff at the date starting the season's last 20% of game dates; held-out stint margin RMSE (per 100 mean controls) against the 1Y impact-ratings-v1 method fitted on the same season's earlier games only and against a team/context ridge. Descriptive diagnostic, not a promotion gate.
Adjacent season-end correlation of RAPM among players qualified in both
acceptance: Two independent runs reproduce every artifact hash
Changing or adding games on or after a cutoff never changes that cutoff's artifact hash
Decayed-seconds-weighted ORAPM and DRAPM means are approximately zero
limitations: Descriptive model estimate under lineup confounding, not isolated skill
The 550-day half-life follows the common public default and is not tuned
negative_result_policy: Publish the diagnostic whichever way it goes, including if time decay does not beat the 1Y fit.
